places: 3.6 km W. of Al-Salmi Border Post

fields.climate: dry desert; intensely hot summers; short, cool winters
fields.terrain: flat to slightly undulating desert plain
fields.hazards: sudden cloudbursts are common from October to April and bring heavy rain, which can damage roads and houses; sandstorms and dust storms occur throughout the year but are most common between March and August
fields.farm: dates, eggs, milk, tomatoes, chicken, lamb/mutton, cucumbers/gherkins, vegetables, maize, eggplants
fields.exports: crude petroleum, refined petroleum, natural gas, hydrocarbons, plastics
fields.industries: petroleum, petrochemicals, cement, shipbuilding and repair, water desalination, food processing, construction materials
fields.legal: mixed system consisting of English common law, French civil law, and Islamic sharia law
fields.suffrage: 21 years of age and at least 20-year citizenship
fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; 12-month compulsory service for men aged 18-35…
